title: Grilled Pineapple with Cinnamon Butter
blurb: Fresh pineapple slices brushed with spiced butter and grilled until caramelised. A simple warm fruit dish that works as a light pudding or a side.
steps: Preheat your grill to medium-high heat.
Peel the pineapple, remove the core, and cut into slices about 2cm thick.
Melt the butter in a small bowl and stir in the cinnamon until combined.
Brush both sides of each pineapple slice generously with the cinnamon butter.
Place the slices on the grill and cook for 5 to 6 minutes on each side until you see char marks and the edges start to caramelise.
Remove from the grill and serve warm.
